verdict.rationale: Notte's core pitch is natural-language operation: you give AI agents natural-language tasks to run on websites, using "One prompt. No selectors", with a documented example prompt ("Go to linkedin.com, login with the credentials and extract the last 10 messages...") and an agent-start API that acts on your behalf. One community user reported a failed extraction attempt on hyatt.com, which lowers confidence in reliability but does not contradict that the capability exists. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of reliable natural-language task execution, and evidence that platform management (sessions, functions, vaults) can be driven by natural language rather than the CLI or SDK.
